steps: Rinse Rice under cold water, then combine with 600 ml Water in a medium saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low; cover and cook 18 minutes until absorbed.
Peel and finely dice Onion; mince 2 cloves Garlic; dice Zucchini into 1 cm cubes.
Slice Carrot (cooked) into thin half-moons, about 3 mm thick.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add Onion and Garlic; cook 3 minutes, stirring, until softened and fragrant.
Add Ground turkey; cook 6 to 8 minutes, breaking up with a spoon, until no pink remains.
Add Zucchini, Carrot (cooked), Ground ginger and Tamari sauce; stir and cook 4 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Spoon Rice into bowls and top with the turkey and vegetable mixture.
Serve immediately; refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
